fdpass.description: Pass file descriptor to clamd instead of streaming (local socket only)

multiscan.description: Enable parallel scanning using multiple threads

allmatch.description: Continue scanning after finding a match

stdout.description: Write messages to stdout (except libclamav output)

move_dir.description: Move infected files to this directory

copy_dir.description: Copy infected files to this directory

reload.description: Request clamd to reload virus signatures

ping_attempts.description: Maximum number of ping attempts to reach clamd

wait.description: Wait up to 30 seconds for clamd to start

file_list.description: Path to file containing newline-separated paths to scan

targets.description: List of files or directories to scan; '-' means stdin
